title: IT Access Provisioning for New Hospital Staff
content: New staff IT access must be requested by the department HOD using Form IT-ACC-01 submitted to the IT Help Desk at least 48 hours before the staff member's start date. Access levels are mapped to the employee's role as defined in the Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) matrix maintained by IT Administration. The IT team will provision HIS login credentials, email account, and role-specific module access within 24 hours of receiving a complete request. Temporary passwords must be changed upon first login; failure to do so within 48 hours triggers an automatic account lock. All access provisioning events are logged in the IT Audit System and reviewed monthly.
